mainEntity.name: What equipment do I need for structured group workouts?

acceptedAnswer.text: For structured group workouts at Cave Training, all necessary specialized fitness equipment is provided at the gym. Participants are generally only required to bring comfortable athletic attire, appropriate athletic shoes, a water bottle, and a towel. Occasionally, a workout might feature specific items like a jump rope, but these are either provided or a coach will advise you if personal items are recommended. Preparation involves ensuring you have suitable activewear.
